environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values using pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` in BLOCK mode with priority 50, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 100. The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:* and all network-related actions. Container runs with read-only root filesystem; SQLite database mounted from EFS with encryption at rest.

config.database: SQLite on EFS mount with encryption at rest
